ordering: Seeded shuffled task blocks; Latin rotation of four cells within each task.
quality: Required-case non-regression and separate human rubric linked to actual measured evidence.
uncertainty: 2000 seeded task-cluster bootstrap replicates; intervals only with at least 8 independent tasks.
confirmation_cost_gate: The lower 95% task-cluster bootstrap saving bound must meet the frozen materiality threshold; undefined ratios or crossing intervals remain unknown.
missing_cost: Retain maximum reservation; mark comparison incomplete/invalid.
missing_blocks: Invalid comparison; retain all attempted results and do not rerun to obtain a favorable outcome.
budget: Reserve the whole worst-case schedule including possible escalations before dispatch.
live_status: Locked by director instruction pending actual billing and price verification.
hardware_metrics: Unobserved; never infer bandwidth, power, kernels or physical runtime controls from API timings.
